description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLog entity class in a PHP project using Doctrine ORM. It models the log entries for actions performed on timesheets within the OrangeHRM system, including properties like action type, comments, date, user who performed the action, and associated timesheet.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log of actions performed on timesheets, with properties for action details, timestamp, user, and linked timesheet.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves the action type of the log entry.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action type of the log entry.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment associated with the log entry.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the log entry.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the log entry.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the log entry.

methods.name: getPerformedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedUser
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with this log.
